speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe in detail the nature of your gait and limb ataxia, when it started, and any specific medical conditions you have in your history.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description, it sounds like you are experiencing significant incoordination, particularly on the right side of your body. How long ago did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES
Given your history of Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab, we must urgently evaluate for Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), a serious side effect of this medication.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain reveals multifocal demyelinating lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). No gadolinium enhancement is noted on T1/T2 images.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
